purpose: Calculates cross-venue prediction market arbitrage: gross spread, fee-adjusted net edge, required capital, and minimum spread to survive fees. Covers Polymarket, Kalshi, SX Bet, and Robinhood. A 6% gross spread nets roughly 1-2% after Kalshi fees. Not financial advice.
